# AAL Fiscal 2015 Financial Figures

## Key Figures for December 31, 2013

- **Professional Fees**: 199 million USD (Source: [AAL fiscal 2015 annual report (10-K), page 183](documents/report.md))
- **Total Reorganization Items, Net**: 2,640 million USD (Source: [AAL fiscal 2015 annual report (10-K), page 183](documents/report.md))
- **Fair Value of Conversion Discount**: 247 million USD (Corrected from 218 million USD, Source: [Data correction notice in AAL fiscal 2015 annual report (10-K), page 183](documents/report.md))
- **Aircraft and Facility Financing Renegotiations and Rejections**: 320 million USD (Source: [AAL fiscal 2015 annual report (10-K), page 183](documents/report.md))

## Portion of Total Net Reorganization Items Related to Professional Fees

The portion of the total net reorganization items related to professional fees is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Portion} = \frac{\text{Professional Fees}}{\text{Total Reorganization Items, Net}} = \frac{199}{2,640} \approx 0.0754 \]

This means that approximately 7.54% of the total net reorganization items are related to professional fees.

- **Fair Value of Conversion Discount**: 247 million USD (Corrected from 218 million USD, Source: [Data correction notice in AAL fiscal 2015 annual report (10-K), page 183](documents/report.md))
- **Aircraft and Facility Financing Renegotiations and Rejections**: 320 million USD (Source: [AAL fiscal 2015 annual report (10-K), page 183](documents/report.md))

## Portion of Total Net Reorganization Items Related to Professional Fees

The portion of the total net reorganization items related to professional fees is calculated as follows:

\[ \text{Portion} = \frac{\text{Professional Fees}}{\text{Total Reorganization Items, Net}} = \frac{199}{2,640} \approx 0.0754 \]

This means that approximately 7.54% of the total net reorganization items are related to professional fees.
